steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Beloved?
Is she the one who called you her true love in that coffin inscription? You frown, taking a cautious step back, but the self-proclaimed bride firmly grabs hold of you.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Of course, I wouldn't mind if you called me "darling" instead—after all, we'll be wedded soon enough. You could also call me dear, honey, sweetheart... whatever you prefer, really.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Or perhaps you'd prefer something more... thrilling? Something special? In that case, you could call me mommy, kitten, your good girl, or even your loyal little slave...
Graves doesn't seem to realize there was anything improper about what she said, gazing at you with an expression of pure innocence.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I think I'll just call you by your name. Graves, you may find this hard to believe, but I don't remember anything, including you. Are we really in a relationship?

You feel a twinge of guilt, worried you might be some soap opera villain who abandoned their lover after a car accident or terminal illness. Luckily, Graves doesn't seem particularly disappointed by your cold demeanor.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Graves... I love the way my name sounds when you say it. What do you want to know? If you're asking about me... just know this: everything I have, everything I am, is yours.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Have I done anything to you?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Well, no—I mean, not yet. After all, we're destined lovers. I've fantasized countless times about our meeting, about giving myself completely to you. Now that you're awake, why don't we...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Perhaps, before we get to that, could you tell me what this place is? It looks like some movie set. Why am I here? How did I get here? Who are you, exactly? And what has happened between us?
Graves seems momentarily stunned by your rapid-fire questions, her surprise written all over her face.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Oh, that's what my dear wants to know! You could have said so earlier.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: (I haven't exactly had the chance...)

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: A proper lover should satisfy their partner's every curiosity. Why don't you rest a little, and let me tell you everything... in detail?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: About... our story.
(Scene change)

A swarm of spiders drags out an ancient, dust-covered sofa from somewhere. You're painfully aware of what lies beneath the fabric—clusters of insect eggs cradled in the worn cotton—but Graves's enthusiastic urging leaves you with little choice but to sit.

Next, a pair of faded, cracked porcelain cups appears before you. Graves picks up the matching teapot with grace and starts pouring. Though not a drop of liquid flows from the spout, she ceremoniously hands you the empty cup as if completing a proper tea service.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Morveth Castle has been abandoned for so many years. I'm afraid I don't have any proper pastries to offer you. Please, do enjoy this tea.
Morveth Castle... why does that name ring a bell? And this peculiar "tea" before you... something about all of this feels oddly familiar.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: What's wrong, dear? Why are your hands trembling? I'm afraid my brewing skills don't match Sister Elsie's. Does it not suit your taste?

You glance at the empty cup in your hands, containing nothing but cobwebs and dust, then look up at Graves's expectant gaze. Despite knowing better, you raise the cup to your lips and pretend to drink from it.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I'll brew tea for you every day from now on.
"That won't be necessary..." you think to yourself, but don't say it aloud.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'd like to know more about our love story. How did we meet? How did we fall in love? And why was I lying in a coffin?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: It truly is a moving, everlasting love story.
You nod eagerly, realizing all the answers are right in front of you. You feel like you might start remembering something soon.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: The story of our love began exactly one hour ago...
But... you've only been here for an hour. Still, Graves appears completely enraptured, so you just keep listening.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: When the moon reached its zenith, I made a wish to the night sky, hoping I too would be granted a destined lover.
Perfect. You've now grasped the basic settings of her story.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Then I waited quietly beneath the moonlight...
Whoa, interesting story arc.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Then... you appeared in the coffin, and so we're lovers now. We're going to live happily ever after together, just like in a fairy tale.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I know, you haven't heard enough, have you? What a touching story! It feels almost unreal, like a hazy, beautiful dream. I truly hope we never ever have to wake up from it.
Her eyes well up with tears. Seeming to realize she's too caught up in her own thoughts, she quickly wipes the corner of her eyes and pours you another cup of "tea."

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Hmm? What's wrong, darling? Why aren't you saying anything? Did I not explain myself clearly?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you saying... we've only just met?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: That's right.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We just fell in love?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Yes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...This so-called love story is actually just beginning.
She smiles with satisfaction while you remain stiffly silent. Unable to fully process her disturbing concept of love, you steel yourself to continue your questioning.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, what kind of person was I before we met?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Whatever works for you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What do you mean by "whatever works"?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: No matter what form my love takes, I would gladly embrace you. Whether you're alive or dead, a creature or even an object—as long as you're the one destined to fulfill my dream, I'll take the vow without hesitation. So none of that really matters.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Even if you'd never awakened in that coffin, it wouldn't have mattered. I had it all planned. I would've spent my life caring for you—watching over that little coffin forever. Every day, I would apply makeup to keep you looking healthy and clean your body with warm water.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I would have watched over you every day, keeping all those spiders and insects away from your corpse...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cor...

You're certain you're alive and well right now, but hearing her say that word still sends chills down your spine. You can't imagine what fate would have awaited you if you hadn't managed to climb out of that coffin.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Um, may I ask one last question?
Your voice is measured, your tone laced with your hidden intention to bolt the moment you get your answer.

options: What will be the ending of this story?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Ending? Could there be any better ending than a perfect wedding?
Marriage? Bride? Wedding? Morveth Castle—these words explode in your mind one after another, triggering fragments of memory:
[Flashback][Bureau][Silhouette]
A Ghost Bride... bound...intruder...marriage pact...
Shrouded her chosen in cobwebs... consume concoctions of insect bones...
Formidable curse... destined love...
[Exit flashback]

You don't recognize the voice, but you're certain it's telling the very story that's unfolding before you. That fleeting thought you couldn't quite hold onto while writing on the dusty floor is now taking shape.
Situation C: The Ghost Bride Who Wouldn't Take No for an Answer...

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Darling, you're full of questions! You must be as excited as I am! Are you just as eager to see us standing together in a sea of flowers, surrounded by guests showering us with blessings?

She doesn't give you time to refuse—THUMP! THUMP! THUMP!
A sudden sound reverberates throughout the hall. Not drums, but footsteps—orderly, steady, countless feet striking the floor in unison with a cold, mechanical rhythm.
Your eyes shoot up, scanning the dome, and it hits you—the sound isn't far away at all. It's coming from directly above, from the floor above this marble surface where you stand.

A chill runs down your spine as you see... shadows. Countless shadows cast down from the sealed-off second floor, blocking the faint moonlight. Grotesque silhouettes—claws, armor, and inhuman limbs—layered upon one another, engulfing the entire staircase.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: They're my friends. Are you ready? The wedding is about to begin.
